decisions.reason: As a close-to-core design extension that remained prominently marketed into 2024, it likely met at least modest aspiration levels and the firm's breadth and industry growth give enough slack to keep it.

This product fits the firm's strategic push toward modern seamless and barrier-free bathrooms, stayed on its own page across both years, and is therefore likely performing satisfactorily relative to aspirations.

Management would likely give this newer pump-drain product more time because the firm has some slack and it builds on existing capabilities, but the earlier disappearance of a related pump-assisted solution makes it noticeably more at risk if results fall short.
